fact: On 17 April 2023, after the first meeting of the SIPAO steering committee, the Minister of Justice said the programme is accompanied by INTERPOL with European Union financing, and that the other forces had not named staff for the central criminal information collection and processing centre, leaving its work to Polícia Judiciária personnel; the PJ director said the integrated criminal information system rests on Law 8/2011.
title: Ministra da Justiça : “SIPAO PERMITIRÁ PARTILHA DE INFORMAÇÃO E DADOS CRIMINAIS A NÍVEL DA CEDEAO”
